name: Yūsui (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yūsui town emblem in light blue: a stylised bird rising above wavy lines.
history: Municipal flag of Yūsui, a town in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 22 March 2005.

features.role: Yūsui town emblem — a stylised bird rising above wavy lines
